name: Joong-Gun
meaning: Named after the patriot Ahn Joong-Gun, who assassinated Hiro-Bumi Ito, the first Japanese governor-general of Korea. The 32 movements match his age when he was executed in 1910.
endingPosition: Bring the left foot back to a ready posture
diagram: Floor diagram image (joong_gun.jpg) with points A to F; no text description on the page.

movements.technique: Middle block with left reverse knife-hand

movements.footwork: Left foot kicks, hands as in 1
movements.technique: Low side front snap kick with left foot

movements.footwork: Lower left foot to B, right foot to B

movements.technique: Middle block with right reverse knife-hand

movements.footwork: Right foot kicks, hands as in 4
movements.technique: Low side front snap kick with right foot

movements.footwork: Lower right foot to A, left foot to A

movements.technique: High vertical punch with twin fist

movements.footwork: Right foot onto line CD, turning counter-clockwise

movements.technique: High side strike with left back fist

movements.footwork: Twist left fist counter-clockwise until back fist faces down; slide left foot to E
Stay in position (15 and 16 performed quickly)
Left foot to right foot, then right foot to F
movements.technique: High side strike with right back fist

movements.footwork: Twist right fist clockwise until back fist faces down; slide right foot to F
Stay in position (18 and 19 performed quickly)
Right foot to left foot, then left foot to C
movements.technique: High block with left double forearm
Middle side piercing kick with right foot
High block with right double forearm
Middle side piercing kick with left foot

movements.footwork: Slide left foot to C; performed slowly
Slide right foot to C; performed slowly
Left foot to right foot; performed slowly
Right foot to left foot, then left foot to B

notes: Movements 15 and 18 are twist-and-slide steps whose technique is only the fist twist; the attack follows in 16 and 19.
